//KeyVault: kv-poshared2 lives in the PoShared resource group. The URI is supplied by appsettings.Development.json locally and by the KeyVault__Uri App Service setting in Azure — never by this file.
//PoFightJudge: Secrets (GeminiApiKey, AzureAd:TenantId/ClientId, TableStorageEndpoint, BlobStorageEndpoint) come from kv-poshared2 as PoFightJudge--*. Everything here is a non-secret default.

PoFightJudge.//Ai: Model ids per operation (SPEC §2, verified 2026-09-06). Config-driven because the published ids move independently of this codebase and the round tier is the main cost knob.

Ai.//TranscribeModel: Whole-recording diarization via interactions. The live turn is TurnTranscribeModel: generateContent will not accept this tier.

PoFightJudge.//Defaults: Debate timings, analysis, and the blob container names are not here: their defaults live on DebateOptions, AnalysisOptions and StorageContainers, and a PoFightJudge:Debate:* (etc.) setting still overrides them.
PoFightJudge.//Toggles: The three switches the app actually has. UseFakes is ignored in Production; UseAzurite only applies in Development.
